title: Cosmobox Level3 S5 campaign summary (v1)
description: The Level3 S5 campaign-level finalization marker: for each of the three geometries, the S4<->S5 primary taxonomy and continuous descriptors for M_TT/R_eff, the four-spin (S2,S3,S4,S5) directional sequence with REVERSAL_COUNT_2345, and a descriptive-only S2/S3/S4/S5 comparison for the control metrics. delta_hl_s2/direction_s2/c_x_23-derived data are read from the frozen Level2 reference; delta_hl_s4/direction_s4/t_x_34/c_x_34/d_x_34 are read from the frozen Level3 S4 reference -- neither is ever recomputed. This document is written ONLY when the campaign is fully complete (3/3 S5 cases, 3/3 geometry comparisons, same repository_commit/manifest_fingerprint/campaign_id, all cases full-spectrum with zero partial subspaces, both frozen references verified): its mere existence on disk is the completeness marker.

campaign_status.description: Always COMPLETE: an incomplete or failed campaign never produces this document at all.

level2_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level2 campaign supplied the S=2/S=3 reference data.

level3_s4_reference.description: Identifies without ambiguity which frozen Level3 S4 campaign supplied the S=4 reference data.

geometries.description: Exactly triangle, ring4, ring5 -- no more, no fewer.

available.description: value is None if and only if reason is set.

reversalCount.description: REVERSAL_COUNT_2345: 0, 1, 2, or 3 when all four directions (S2,S3,S4,S5) are resolved, else the literal string NOT_EVALUABLE. Descriptive only -- never a convergence criterion.

delta_hl_s2.description: Pinned from the frozen Level2 campaign-summary -- never recomputed.

delta_hl_s3.description: Pinned from the frozen Level2 campaign-summary -- never recomputed.

delta_hl_s4.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S4 campaign-summary -- never recomputed from a re-executed S4 case.

t_x_34.description: abs(delta_hl_s4 - delta_hl_s3), pinned from the frozen Level3 S4 campaign-summary.

r_delta_x_45_34.description: t_x_45 / t_x_34, only when t_x_34 > 0. No threshold associated.

c_x_34.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S4 campaign-summary.

d_x_34.description: Pinned from the frozen Level3 S4 campaign-summary.

c_x_45.description: Computed with the same profiles.cross_profile_correlation primitive as C_X_34, on the S4<->S5 pair.

d_x_45.description: Computed with the same profiles.cross_profile_distance primitive as D_X_34, on the S4<->S5 pair.

r_d_x_45_34.description: d_x_45 / d_x_34, only when d_x_34 > 0. No threshold associated.

primaryS4S5Comparison.description: Mirrors the S4<->S5 primary comparison contract of docs/levels/level3/s5-second-extension-preregistration.md sections 8-10 exactly.

controlS4S5Comparison.description: Deliberately has NO primary_s4_s5_taxonomy/reversal_count_2345/shape-descriptor property -- additionalProperties:false makes it a schema error to include one (control channel never creates or overrides a primary result).
